履修条件

授業概要
う蝕や歯周病の予防法や発症予測または口腔細菌叢を含めた口腔と全身の健康の関係について、研究成果をまとめ論文を執筆する。
The students write the research paper about the prevention and predictive method for dental caries and periodontal disease and the association between oral health including oral microbiome and systemic health.
